params.body: Pins release v0.20.1 (the capability kept beside the record, #55; the relying party following a successor identity, #57) in startup.sh with the sha256 of control-gateway-linux-amd64 from the release's SHA256SUMS, checked here against the downloaded asset. Supersedes the v0.20.0 pin of #56 before it reached the VM. After merge: pull main, rehearse.sh upgrade.
params.title: The VM on v0.20.1
